data.name: Keyaan
data.gender_notes: Keyaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kayna' meaning 'to be given'. Keyaan symbolizes the blessings and gifts bestowed by Allah upon an individual. This name evokes a sense of gratitude and appreciation for the divine blessings in life. The name Keyaan carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Keyaan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's infinite blessings and generosity.
data.etymology: Keyaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Keyaan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: كيان

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'كيان' مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ك-ي-ن' الذي يحمل معاني القوة و الازدهار و النمو. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن قوة الله و عظمته. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لتعبر عن الشخصية القوية و المزدهرة.

in_urdu.name: کیان
in_urdu.meaning: مذکر نام، معنی: طاقت، ترقی، نمو
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام 'کیان' عربی جڑ 'ک-ی-ن' سے نکلا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں طاقت، ترقی اور نمو۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں طاقت ور اور ترقی یافتہ شخصیت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں اللہ کی طاقت اور عظمت کے حوالے سے کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कयान
in_hindi.meaning: पुंलिंग नाम, अर्थ: शक्ति, उन्नति, विकास
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम 'कयान' अरबी मूल 'क-य-न' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति, उन्नति और विकास। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में मजबूत और समृद्ध व्यक्तित्व के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में अल्लाह की शक्ति और महिमा के संदर्भ में किया गया है।

in_pashto.name: کیان
in_pashto.meaning: مذکر نوم، معنی: ځواک، پرمختګ، وده

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi, Al-Mawasit wal-Ittibar, Cairo, 1321 AH/1903 AD, mentions a city named Keyaan in Yemen during the reign of Al-Mansur Bil-Allah (1217-1232 AD) as an important commercial center.

Ibn Battuta, The Travels of Ibn Battuta, Rashid Al-Din, 1304-1369 AD, describes Keyaan as a fortified town in the Hadramaut region of Yemen, and a major caravan stop on the trade route between Yemen and India during the 14th century AD.
